_comment_overview: Full VerificationConfig preset showing all commonly used fields. Comments live outside the 'config' object because VerificationConfig uses extra=forbid. Remove fields to use defaults. Load with VerificationConfig.from_preset(path) or karenina verify --preset path.
_comment_answering_models: Models that generate answers. Empty list valid only when parsing_only=True.
_comment_parsing_models: Models that parse/judge responses. At least one is always required.
_comment_replicate_count: Number of independent runs per question/model combination.
_comment_parsing_only: When true, skip answer generation (for TaskEval). answering_models can be empty.
_comment_evaluation_mode: template_only | template_and_rubric | rubric_only. Default template_only; rubrics are evaluated only when an explicit mode includes them.
_comment_rubric_evaluation_strategy: batch: all LLM traits in one call. sequential: one call per trait.
_comment_trace_control: Control what portion of MCP agent trace is passed to evaluation.
_comment_guards: Guard stages that auto-fail questions before parsing.
_comment_extraction_hints: Append extraction hints to the parsing prompt.
_comment_deep_judgment_template: Deep judgment for template verification: excerpt extraction and validation. Modes: disabled, reasoning_only, full.
_comment_deep_judgment_rubric: Deep judgment for rubric traits. Modes: disabled, enable_all, use_checkpoint, custom.
_comment_few_shot: Few-shot prompting configuration. Set to null to disable.
_comment_prompt_config: Per-task custom instructions injected into pipeline LLM calls.
_comment_agentic_parsing: Agentic parsing: judge uses tools to independently verify artifacts. Requires parsing model with agent_tier='deep_agent'.
_comment_db_config: Database configuration for automatic result persistence.
_comment_scenario_turn_limit: Max turns before forced termination in scenario execution.
_comment_request_timeout: Per-request HTTP timeout in seconds for LLM calls.
_comment_partial_trace: Allow scoring partial traces (e.g. timeout-interrupted agent runs).

answering_models.system_prompt: You are an expert assistant. Answer the question accurately and concisely.

parsing_models.system_prompt: You are a validation assistant. Parse and validate responses against the given Pydantic template.
